_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC. The reading a plain count renders as a lie. This first-stage engine's config sets literalZeroIgnitions, so its budget of ZERO survives RealFuels' normalisation and means the engine will light ONLY on a launch clamp: there is no in-flight relight to be had at all. Every other configured zero is rewritten to the unlimited sentinel on the way in, so the same wire value carries opposite briefings and the count alone cannot tell them apart. GROUND ONLY is what the operator needs; '0 LEFT' would read as a spent budget on an engine that never had one, and 'UNLIMITED' would be catastrophically wrong. The second engine beside it has a reading the Uplink could not take, and shows a dash rather than a substituted zero.

_scene.caption: A ground-start-only first stage: a zero budget rendered as the restriction it is, beside an engine whose reading is absent
